description: What a project is: its name and main scene from project.godot, the Godot that answers, and how many scenes, scripts and assets it holds, other counting every remaining file, leaving out the addons gdharness installed and any folder holding a .gdignore, with optional sections on top.

detail.description: full adds what to do about it to every validation finding. Default summary.

include.description: Extra sections: registered autoloads, the input actions project.godot holds with their events (an engine ui_ action only when the project rebinds it, as engineAction), addons and whether each is enabled, export presets, the audio bus layout, a health report, or export validation. health and validation compile every script of the project in headless engines and name each that fails with its first error, and each file a scene, resource or script refers to that does not exist.

preset.description: For validation: the export preset to validate against.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

name: project_info
title: Project info
